name: forever-companion
description: A read-only coach for World of Warcraft: Forever. Knows your character from the Forever Companion addon, gives hints rather than routes, and helps with builds and gold.
long_description: A read-only coach for World of Warcraft: Forever. It reads the snapshot the bundled Forever Companion addon saves in game, keeps each player's playstyle profile and each character's talent plan, and gives hints through a three-level ladder (nudge, direction, answer) that the connector controls. It installs and updates the addon itself, and never touches the running game. Location data from warcraft.wiki.gg (CC BY-SA).
